notes.title: Somniora: Chapter 1 – Delayed to Fall 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217674/744517ebbe93dac593ca02c810e2fe192c5b0a39.jpg[/img]

We’ve made a difficult decision Somniora: Chapter 1 has been delayed to Fall 2025.
This wasn’t an easy call. We know many of you were looking forward to the full release, and we truly share your disappointment. But after reviewing the demo feedback and assessing our remaining workload, we realized that releasing now would mean compromising the vision and depth we’ve worked so hard to build.

We want Somniora to be something you’ll remember a haunting, emotional, and polished experience. To deliver on that promise, we need more time.

Thank you for sticking with us. Your support means everything. We’re still here, still building, and still committed.
Fall 2025. That’s when the nightmare continues. 🌙
